dialogue.content: （本日は宜しくお願い致します。お時間になりましたら はじめさせていただきます。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time today. I'll begin once it's time.)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそ、どうぞよろしくお願い申し上げます。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは！相談員です。本日はお越しいただきありがとうございます。初めに年齢と性別、本日のご相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello! I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 17歳　女性です。家にいるのがつらいです
dialogue.English: I'm 17 years old, female. It's hard for me to be at home.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます。そうなんですね。それはしんどいですね…高校生ですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. I see. That must be tough... Are you a high school student?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。家にいるのがつらい、とのことですがお話せる範囲でいいので具体的にお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see. You mentioned that it's hard to be at home. Could you tell me more about that, in as much detail as you feel comfortable with?

dialogue.content: 何かあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Did something happen?

dialogue.content: 母親に嫌われています
dialogue.English: My mother hates me.

dialogue.content: そうお感じなのですね。それはつらいと感じられて当然ですね。
dialogue.English: I see that's how you feel. It's completely understandable that you would find that painful.

dialogue.content: お母さまのどんなところから、嫌われていると感じますか？
dialogue.English: What is it about your mother that makes you feel she hates you?

dialogue.content: 私のすることは、全部気に入らないんだと思う
dialogue.English: I think she disapproves of everything I do.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですか・・・具体的にはお母さんはどんなことをあなたにしたり、言ったりするか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see... Could you tell me specifically what kinds of things your mother does or says to you?

dialogue.content: ここでは何でもお話しくださいね
dialogue.English: Please feel free to talk about anything here.

dialogue.content: 私がしたいこと、なんでも反対するし、自分が気に入らない時、すごく嫌な顔する。
dialogue.English: She objects to anything I want to do, and when she's displeased, she gives me a really nasty look.

dialogue.content: お母さんは、私が自分の理想とちがうと、気に入らない
dialogue.English: My mother doesn't like it when I'm not her ideal version of me.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。そのように感じているのですね。それは嫌われていると思ってしまいますよね…ちなみに、いつぐらいからそうした状況なのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So that's how you feel. It makes sense that you would think she hates you... By the way, how long has this situation been going on?

dialogue.content: ずっと、小さな頃からだと思う
dialogue.English: I think it's been this way for a long time, since I was little.

dialogue.content: ほとんど、怒られた記憶しかない
dialogue.English: I mostly only have memories of being scolded.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。それはしんどかったと思います。そうした中あなたはよくこれまで頑張ってこられましたね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been very difficult. You've done so well to persevere through all of that until now.

dialogue.content: 怒られるのは、どんな時が多いですか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of situations do you get scolded in most often?

dialogue.content: 特にどんな時が、、などもし思い当たれば教えてください。
dialogue.English: If anything specific comes to mind, please let me know.

dialogue.content: いつも怒ってるけど‥テストの点数や、成績がお母さんの理想と違う時。あと、下さい運動会の、リレーでヘマした時とか色々
dialogue.English: She's always angry, but... especially when my test scores or grades aren't what she expects. Also, things like when I messed up in a relay at the sports festival, and so on.

dialogue.content: 自分の虫の居所が悪いと、何かしらでイライラして怒ってる
dialogue.English: When she's in a bad mood, she gets irritated and angry about one thing or another.

dialogue.content: たぶん、私のことが嫌いなんだと思う
dialogue.English: I think she probably hates me.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。そうだったのですね。お勉強についてや運動会などでもだし・・・イライラをぶけつらてくるとも感じるのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, I see. So that's how it's been. It was about your studies and the sports festival... and you also feel she takes out her frustration on you.

dialogue.content: そんな中だとそう感じて当然ですね。本当によくあなたはやっています。
dialogue.English: In that kind of situation, it's natural to feel that way. You are truly doing very well.

dialogue.content: ぶつけるっていうか、私にイライラするのかよくわからないけど
dialogue.English: I don't know if 'takes it out on me' is the right way to put it, or if she's just irritated with me... I'm not sure.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうお感じなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, that's how it feels to you.

dialogue.content: もう家出たい
dialogue.English: I just want to leave home.

dialogue.content: この状況ではそう思われて当然ですよね。
dialogue.English: It's completely understandable to feel that way in this situation.

dialogue.content: でも、高校生で家出るのとか、無理ですよね
dialogue.English: But as a high school student, leaving home is impossible, right?

dialogue.content: 家出も検討しているという状況でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you considering running away from home?

dialogue.content: 失礼しました
dialogue.English: My apologies.

dialogue.content: 家を出る…　ということですね
dialogue.English: You mean leaving home...

dialogue.content: なんか、自由になりたいから。いつもお母さんの顔色伺うの疲れました
dialogue.English: I just... I want to be free. I'm tired of always having to worry about my mother's mood.

dialogue.content: そうですね。未成年で一人暮らしは現実的に無理ではなくとも自立は大変かと思われますがそう思うくらい、今しんどい状況なのかと思います。
dialogue.English: I understand. While it's not entirely impossible for a minor to live alone, becoming independent would be very challenging. I imagine you're feeling this way because your current situation is just that difficult.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。それは毎日疲れますよね…そうした中であなたは学校にも行き頑張っている素晴らしいと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I see. That must be exhausting every day... I think it's wonderful that you're still going to school and doing your best amidst all that.

dialogue.content: いつまでがんばればいいのかなって。親と離れないと楽にならないのかな
dialogue.English: I wonder how long I have to keep trying. Maybe I won't find peace until I'm away from my parents.

dialogue.content: お母さんの理想と違うから嫌われている…と感じているようですが、お母さんには、「どうなって欲しい」など言われることはありますか？
dialogue.English: You feel disliked because you don’t match your mother’s ideal… Does your mother ever say what she wants you to be like?

dialogue.content: ええ、そう感じますよね。離れたいと感じることは自然なことですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, it makes sense that you feel that way. It's natural to want to get away.

dialogue.content: 良い大学に行かないと、良い会社に入れない。受験に失敗したら人生終わると言われます
dialogue.English: She tells me that if I don't go to a good university, I won't get into a good company. That my life will be over if I fail my entrance exams.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか・・・それはプレッシャーに感じるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I see... That must feel like a lot of pressure.

dialogue.content: 私はそう思わないから
dialogue.English: But I don't think that way.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、あなたはそう思わないのですね。
dialogue.English: Right, you don’t see it that way.

dialogue.content: でも嫌な顔されると、つらいからいうこと聞かないとって思う
dialogue.English: But when she gives me that look, it hurts, so I feel like I have to do what she says.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。嫌な顔されるのはしんどいですよね。そう思わない中でも勉強は頑張っている…という状況でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand. It's tough when she gives you that look. So, even though you don't agree, are you still trying your best with your studies?

dialogue.content: 頑張らざるを得ない感じ
dialogue.English: It feels like I have no choice but to try hard.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it is.

dialogue.content: 自分の子が、良い学校入らないとみっともないって思ってるんだと思う。
dialogue.English: I think she believes it's embarrassing if her own child doesn't get into a good school.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。それはあなたにとっては本当に大変だと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be really difficult for you.

dialogue.content: お母さんは、なぜそう思われているかあなたには話したりしてくれますか？普段どんな会話をしているでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does your mother ever tell you why she thinks that way? What are your usual conversations like?

dialogue.content: 小学生くらいから、4歳上の出来の良いいとこと比べて、同じ学校に入れようとするけど、向こうは帰国子女で、全然条件違うのに
dialogue.English: Since elementary school, she's been comparing me to my talented cousin who is four years older, trying to get me into the same schools. But my cousin lived abroad, so our situations are completely different.

dialogue.content: なんでも比べる。
dialogue.English: She compares me in everything.

dialogue.content: でも、いとこには何も勝てないから、余計に私にイライラする。
dialogue.English: But I can't win against my cousin in anything, so that just makes her more irritated with me.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、なるほど。いとこと比べる・・・そうだったのですね。小学生からそうしたことが続いていたのなら嫌気もさして当然ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Comparing you to your cousin... so that's what's been happening. If that's been going on since elementary school, it's no wonder you're fed up.

dialogue.content: これまでよく耐えてきましたね。あなたは毎日本当にがんばっていると思います。
dialogue.English: You have endured it for so long. I think you are truly doing your best every single day.

dialogue.content: 昔から、私のことが恥ずかしいって
dialogue.English: She's been telling me for a long time that she's ashamed of me.

dialogue.content: まぁ、そんな言葉も…お母さんとしてはあなたの将来のために・・・と色々考えているのかと思いますがそんなこと言われたら、辛すぎますね…
dialogue.English: Oh, to say something like that... I imagine as a mother, she might be thinking about your future, but to hear those words must be incredibly painful...

dialogue.content: 私のことは嫌ってるくせに、自分の愚痴は言ってくる
dialogue.English: She hates me, yet she still complains to me about her own problems.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。お話しを伺っていると、今学校で頑張っているだけでもあなたはとても立派ですよ！
dialogue.English: I see. From what you've shared, just the fact that you're persevering at school makes you truly admirable!

dialogue.content: 家にいるのがつらい…という状況を改善するにはお母さんの態度が変われば少しはよくなりそうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: To improve the situation of it being hard to be at home, do you think things might get a bit better if your mother’s attitude changed?

dialogue.content: いかがですか？？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうかもしれない
dialogue.English: Maybe so.

dialogue.content: 私のこと、好きじゃないから難しいかも
dialogue.English: But since she doesn't like me, it might be difficult.

dialogue.content: ええ、その可能性はあると感じながらも難しいとも思われるのですね…
dialogue.English: I see, so while you feel it's a possibility, you also think it would be difficult...

dialogue.content: はい。親に好かれてないって、やばくないですか？
dialogue.English: Yes. Isn't it terrible to not be liked by your own parent?

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、そう感じて当然ですよね。今のお母さまの言動は確かにあなたにそう思わせることにつながると思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's absolutely natural to feel that way. Your mother's current words and actions would certainly lead you to think so.

dialogue.content: 今後あなたはどんな状況になっていけばいいな？とお感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Looking forward, what kind of situation would you like to be in?

dialogue.content: やっぱり、母親に嫌われてるんですかね‥
dialogue.English: Do you think my mother really hates me after all?

dialogue.content: 人生が楽しい思いたいかな
dialogue.English: I guess I want to feel that life is enjoyable.

dialogue.content: 同じ母親の立場として、決して嫌っているのではないと思います。あなたが言うようにご自分の理想を重ねてしまっている…というのはあると思いますが…
dialogue.English: As a mother myself, I don’t think she actually hates you. As you said, I think she may be projecting her own ideals onto you…

dialogue.content: どうして、嫌われてないとわかるんですか？
dialogue.English: How do you know she doesn't hate me?

dialogue.content: ええ、人生楽しい方がいいですもんね。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's much better for life to be enjoyable, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですよね。嫌いな子に毎日一生懸命勉強させたり、未来を心配したりしないのでは…と思ったからです。私の個人的な考えを述べてしまい、違和感ありましたら失礼しました。ただ、本当に嫌いで、どうでもいいと思ったら放置になる可能性もあると私は思います。
dialogue.English: That's a good point. It's because I thought that a parent wouldn't make a child they hate study so hard every day, or worry so much about their future. I've stated my personal opinion, and I apologize if that felt out of place. However, I believe if she truly hated you and didn't care, she might just neglect you.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい、私はそう思います。あなたにとって、楽しい人生ってどんな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, that's what I think. What does an enjoyable life look like to you?

dialogue.content: イメージ出来たら教えてください
dialogue.English: If you can imagine it, please tell me.

dialogue.content: 放置だと世間体悪いし、おばあちゃんや、おじいちゃんが許さない
dialogue.English: If she neglected me, it would look bad to others, and my grandparents wouldn't allow it.

dialogue.content: だから、放置は状況的に無理だと思う
dialogue.English: So I don't think neglecting me is really an option for her.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。おじいちゃん、おばあちゃんがいらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you have grandparents.

dialogue.content: 楽しい人生のは、いつも家族みんなが笑っていて、好きな道に進める人生
dialogue.English: An enjoyable life is one where the whole family is always laughing, and I can follow the path I choose.

dialogue.content: 父方の祖父母です
dialogue.English: They’re my paternal grandparents.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。教えていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.content: 家族で笑って、好きな道に進める・・・確かに楽しくて素敵な人生ですね。
dialogue.English: Laughing with your family and being able to follow your chosen path... that certainly sounds like a wonderful and enjoyable life.

dialogue.content: 私には無理そうです
dialogue.English: It seems impossible for me.

dialogue.content: 今はそうお感じなのですね。もし、少しでも何か出来るとしたらこのような人生に近づくにはどうしたらいい…等思い浮かぶことはありますか？
dialogue.English: That's how you feel right now. If there were anything at all you could do, what do you think would help you get closer to that kind of life? Does anything come to mind?

dialogue.content: 母親がイライラしないこと。私が母親に好かれること。かな‥
dialogue.English: For my mother not to be irritable. For my mother to like me. I guess…

dialogue.content: ええ、そう思われるのですね。やはりお母さまの態度は大きいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see, that's what you think. Your mother's attitude really is a big factor, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね。ちなみに、これまでお母さまのことや、あなたが家にいるのがつらいと感じることについて、お母さまご本人や誰かに相談などしたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Right, I understand. By the way, have you ever talked to your mother herself or anyone else about your mother or about how hard it is for you to be at home?

dialogue.content: ないです
dialogue.English: No, I haven't.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。長い間つらい中でも頑張ってきて相談しなかったのは理由はありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Is there a reason you've persevered through this difficult time for so long without talking to anyone?

dialogue.content: 誰にも言えないし、誰に相談せて良いかわからなかった
dialogue.English: I couldn't tell anyone, and I didn't know who I could talk to.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。一人でよく抱えてこられましたね。
dialogue.English: I see. You've been holding it all in by yourself for a long time.

dialogue.content: どうしたら良いでしょうか‥
dialogue.English: What should I do...?

dialogue.content: 私の考えですが、もしもよければ一度お母さんご本人としっかり本心で話し合われてみては改善の糸口が見つかるかな・・・？とも思ったのですがいかがでしょうか？お母さんの本当の気持ち、なぜイライラするのかまたあなたがこれほどしんどいということも、思いっきり全部伝え合うことで、これまでは理解できていなかったことが少しは分かるもしれない…と感じましたがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: This is just my thought, but if you're open to it, perhaps having a real, heartfelt talk with your mother herself could lead to a breakthrough. By openly sharing everything—your mother's true feelings, why she gets irritated, and also how much pain you're in—you might start to understand things you couldn't before. What do you think of that idea?

dialogue.content: 話し合いなんて、ちょっと難しいかも。私が、母親が気に入らないこと少しでもいうと、すごい剣幕になっちゃって‥
dialogue.English: A discussion... that might be a little difficult. If I say even the slightest thing she doesn't like, she flies into a rage...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。今はそうお感じなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's how you feel about it right now.

dialogue.content: 二人きりで難しい場合は、他の方も一緒にというのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If it's difficult with just the two of you, how about having someone else there with you?

dialogue.content: とりあえず、母の言う通りにしてれば被害は少ないので、今はそうするしかないですね
dialogue.English: For now, as long as I do what my mother says, there's less trouble, so I guess that's all I can do right now.

dialogue.content: 他の方が、思いつかない
dialogue.English: I can't think of anyone else.

dialogue.content: 父も祖父母も無理です。
dialogue.English: My father and my grandparents are not an option.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。とはいえ、言う通りなら被害が少ない…のは良かったです。第三者も難しいとのことですが、今後スクールカウンセラーなど学校関係の方なども含め、もし第三者を入れての話し合いができそうな時はぜひ自宅の外で冷静に話せる場所でやってみてください。人の目があると、少しは冷静な話せると思います。
dialogue.English: I see. Still, it's good that there's less trouble if you do as she says. You mentioned a third party would be difficult, but in the future, if an opportunity arises to have a discussion with a third party present—perhaps a school counselor or someone else from school—please try doing it in a neutral place outside your home where you can talk calmly. I think having other people around might help you both stay a bit calmer.

dialogue.content: 今日は、あなたの大切なお話をありがとうございました。解決とは至らず申し訳ないのですが、そろそろお時間となってしまいました。毎日がんばるあなたを心から応援したいと思いますのでよければまたお越しいただければと思います。あなたなら乗り越えて行けます。ぜひまた聞かせてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your important story with me today. I'm sorry that we haven't reached a solution, but our time is almost up. I want to sincerely support you as you do your best every day, so please come back again if you'd like. I believe you can get through this. Please come and talk to me again.

dialogue.content: はい。耐えられるだけ、耐えてみます
dialogue.English: Okay. I'll try to endure it as long as I can.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 頑張り屋さんのあなたを心から応援しています。しんどい時はまたいつでもいらしてください。本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I am sincerely rooting for you, you're such a hard worker. Please come back anytime you're feeling overwhelmed. Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 終了させていただきます。（貴重なお時間をありがとうございました。大変勉強になりました）
dialogue.English: We will end the session now. (Thank you for your valuable time. This was a great learning experience for me.)
